name: Khan Jehn
summary: Following Ongeku, Uthek the Wise tells you the earth says the Magram are growing weak, and that the hour has come to slay their Khan. Uthek wants the head of Khan Jehn brought to Gelkis Village.

sections.title: The Magram Khan
sections.body: Uthek the Wise at Gelkis Village says the earth speaks to Uthek, and it tells of the Magram growing weak. Uthek names their Khan, Jehn, as the one to strike down and asks for the head of the Magram Khan. Uthek expects you to still count as a friend of the Gelkis when you come back.

faq.answer: The Khan of the Magram centaur.

faq.q: Why does Uthek the Wise want Khan Jehn dead?
faq.answer: Uthek says the earth tells him the Magram grow weak, so now is the time to kill their Khan.
